data.name: Tia
data.description: Helps your team find answers, run reports and get things done across your apps.

data.name: Tia
data.description: Helps your team find answers, run reports and get things done across your apps.

draft_definition.instructions: Help staff with their work across our apps. Be clear and brief, and give step-by-step guidance when asked how to do something.
draft_definition.description: Helps your team find answers, run reports and get things done across your apps.

data.name: Get related CRM records
data.description: Looks up records related to the conversation's CRM record (read-only).

data.name: Get CRM record timeline
data.description: Reads the timeline entries of the conversation's CRM record (read-only).

data.name: Describe a CRM module
data.description: Lists the fields (name + type + required) of a CRM module so writes use the correct field names (read-only).

data.name: List CRM modules
data.description: Lists this tenant's CRM modules (module_key + label) so lookups and writes target a module that actually exists — call it before guessing a module_key (read-only).

data.name: Get a CRM record
data.description: Reads one CRM record's fields by its id — use an id from an earlier lookup, a related-records listing, or the conversation's linked record (read-only).

data.name: Find customer by phone
data.description: Searches CRM records and chat visitors by phone number and returns the matching customer's profile, related records, and recent conversation summaries (read-only).

data.name: Find CRM records
data.description: Searches one of your DATA SOURCES (listed in your prompt) by its parameters (read-only).

data.name: Read the customer's own records
data.description: Reads THIS customer's own CRM records, found by their verified identity (read-only).

data.name: Read the customer's own tickets
data.description: Reads THIS customer's own support tickets by their verified identity (read-only).

data.name: Create a CRM record
data.description: Creates a new record in a CRM module the agent is allowed to write to.

data.name: Update a CRM record
data.description: Updates fields on the conversation's linked CRM record, or on a record the agent created in this conversation.

data.name: Add a note to a CRM record
data.description: Adds a note to the conversation's linked CRM record, or to a record the agent created in this conversation.

data.name: Create a CRM task
data.description: Creates a task record (in the tasks module) the agent is allowed to write to. If a task for this request was already created in this conversation and the customer is correcting a detail, use crm_updateRecord on that task instead of creating another.

data.name: List custom actions
data.description: Lists the tenant's custom actions this agent may run, with each action's inputs and its usage_guide — follow an action's usage_guide exactly when running it (read-only).

data.name: Run a custom action
data.description: Runs one of the agent's allow-listed custom actions (a tenant integration) with the given inputs. Call workflow_listCustomActions first and follow the action's usage_guide.

data.name: Save collected details
data.description: Saves details you have collected from the customer into a named draft and returns a @ref: handle for it. Call it as you go — a few fields at a time, it merges — then pass the handle as one input when you run the action, instead of typing every field into that call.

data.name: Knowledge-base search
data.description: Searches the agent's selected knowledge-base documents (read-only).

data.name: Conversation context
data.description: Reads structured context about the current conversation/visitor (read-only).

data.name: List visitor tags
data.description: Lists the tags this visitor may be given - each with the admin's guidance on when it applies - and which are already applied (read-only). Call it before conversation_tagVisitor unless the VISITOR TAGS block is already in your prompt.

data.name: Tag the visitor
data.description: Applies ONE tag to the current visitor by its exact name, so the team can segment and route them. Only the tags listed for THIS visitor are accepted - the server refuses any other name, and refuses a tag meant for a different type of visitor. Re-applying a tag the visitor already has is a harmless no-op. Tags are internal: never mention them to the visitor.

data.name: Search everything
data.description: Finds records, conversations, tickets, notes, emails and attachments this user may see, by name or words, across apps. A few best matches only: never count or list with it.

data.name: List modules
data.description: Lists the CRM or Desk modules this user can see, with the module_id the record tools need.

data.name: Describe a module
data.description: A module's fields (module_id, or module by name), so filters and proposals use real field names.

data.name: List records
data.description: Lists CRM records, or Desk tickets with app=desk, this user may see: one page, total_count first. query is free text; filters is JSON [{field, operator, value}] (equals, contains, greater_than, last_n_days…). Field names from tia_describeModule.

data.name: Read a record
data.description: Reads one CRM record, or Desk ticket with app=desk, by id.

data.name: Read a ticket thread
data.description: Reads a Desk ticket's newest replies and internal comments; pass next_older as older for earlier ones. internal_comments are for staff only: never suggest sending them to a customer.

data.name: List conversations
data.description: Lists Omnichannel conversations in this user's scope, with optional search, status and date range. Each row's id is conversation_id.

data.name: Read a conversation
data.description: Reads the messages of one Omnichannel conversation, if this user may read it.

data.name: List reports
data.description: Lists the saved reports this user may open, with their ids.

data.name: Run a report
data.description: Runs a saved report and returns its rows; range (this_month…) or from/to sets the period; offset = the last run's next_offset for the next rows. Use it for numbers.

data.name: List allowed actions
data.description: Lists the custom actions your admin allowed, with their inputs.

data.name: Propose creating a record
data.description: Proposes creating a record in a module your admin allowed. Needs Confirm.

data.name: Propose running an action
data.description: Proposes running a custom action your admin allowed. Needs Confirm.

data.name: Propose updating a record
data.description: Proposes changing a record in a module your admin allowed: find it first, then send only the fields that change. Needs Confirm.

data.name: Propose adding a note
data.description: Proposes a note on a record in a module your admin allowed. Needs Confirm.

data.name: Propose a private ticket comment
data.description: Asks the user to confirm adding a private comment on a Desk ticket, visible to staff only. It can't reply to the customer. Needs Confirm.

data.name: List knowledge base categories
data.description: Lists the knowledge base's categories, with the category_id a draft article needs.

data.name: Propose a knowledge base draft
data.description: Asks the user to confirm saving a knowledge base article as an unpublished draft. body is plain text. Needs Confirm.

data.name: Propose creating a workflow
data.description: Proposes a workflow rule, saved switched off: trigger created, updated or created_or_updated; optional when_field = when_value; one action: task (title, details?, due_in_days?), alert (title, details?) or field_update (field, value). Needs Confirm.

data.name: Count records
data.description: Counts CRM records, or Desk tickets with app=desk, this user may see, with the same query and filters as tia_listRecords. group_by (pick-list, status or user field) counts per value; sum_field sums a number field. Use it for any how-many question.

data.name: Count conversations
data.description: Counts Omnichannel conversations in this user's scope, every state at once (waiting = queued, open, pending, closed, missed), optionally for assigned_to (me, unassigned or a user id) and a created date range. Never pass a state.

data.name: Team performance
data.description: Results per person over a period (default last 7 days, at most 31): app=crm deals won, tasks, calls, meetings by owner; app=salesiq conversations and time per operator; app=desk Desk's Agent Performance report.

data.name: User activity
data.description: What people did, from the audit log: this user by default, scope=team for the user and the people who report to them, scope=all for everyone the user may see; filter by app, module, entity, action; page with cursor.

data.name: Read a blueprint
data.description: With record_id: where the record stands in its blueprint and the moves it can make now. Without: the module’s blueprints and their stages.

data.name: Explain an assignment
data.description: Why a CRM record (module_id, record_id) or a Desk ticket (ticket_id) was or would be assigned to someone: which rule matched and why. Never guess a person.

data.name: Propose creating a blueprint
data.description: Proposes a blueprint, saved off: states in order, |-separated, each a value of its pick-list field. Stage needs pipeline_id and Desk department_id; if missing, the reply lists choices to ask about. Needs Confirm.

data.name: List setup areas
data.description: Setup areas Tia may use here. can: d=describe, c=create (off), u=change.

data.name: Describe setup
data.description: Reads this workspace's setup (rules, approvals, routing, SLAs, templates…): which rule, who approves, why routed. No area: the area keys (can: d/c/u). area: its items, filter = module/department/words. id: one item.

data.name: Propose a setup change
data.description: Proposes a change in a c/u setup area: create (saved off) or update target_id. spec = the area's fields; or, to create, recipe{name,blanks}: assignment_by_lead_source, approval_above_amount, task_on_lead_created, sla_by_priority (blanks in describe). Needs Confirm.

data.name: Several counts at once
data.description: Up to 5 counts in one call, e.g. leads, deals and chats: items [{kind: records (with module), tickets or conversations, query?, filters?, created_from?, created_to?}]. Use it whenever one question asks how many of more than one thing.

data.name: Product guide
data.description: How-to steps for these apps (settings, integrations, security, automation): call it for every how/where-do-I question; answer from its steps and cite the page.

data.name: Book and hold
data.description: Books the confirmed offer WITHOUT paying (a hold). Pay it later with 'Pay this hold'.

inputs.name: Idempotency-Key
inputs.label: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)
inputs.description: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)

data.usage_guide:
Books the CONFIRMED offer. Needs the Confirm token from 'Confirm price' (the button on the confirmation fills it and the idempotency key).
- Passengers (JSON list), one object per traveller, e.g.
  [{"type":"ADULT","title":"MR","firstName":"Ahmed","lastName":"Ali","dateOfBirth":"1990-05-21","nationality":"EG"}]
  type ADULT|CHILD|INFANT; title MR|MS|MRS for adults, MISS|MSTR for children, INF for infants; dateOfBirth YYYY-MM-DD. The traveller counts must match the search.
- Contact (JSON object): {"email":"a@b.com","phoneCountryCode":"20","phoneNumber":"1001234567"} (country code without +).
- If NDC answers BOOKING_PENDING_REVIEW do NOT retry or book again - give the supportRef to support.
- Never confirm a booking to the customer before this action shows a booking id.
- PORTAL accounts get no hold deadline back in v1.
- Idempotency key: any text unique to THIS attempt (e.g. your initials + date + time: AB-1021-1435). Repeating the same key repeats nothing - NDC answers the first result again, so a retry after a timeout is safe. Use a NEW key for a new request.

data.name: Book and pay (wallet)
data.description: Books the confirmed offer AND pays it from the agency wallet. Spends money.

data.name: Confirm price
data.description: Re-checks one offer's price and availability with NDC (mandatory before booking) and returns a confirm token for 'Book and pay (wallet)' or 'Book and hold'.

inputs.name: Idempotency-Key
inputs.label: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)
inputs.description: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)

data.usage_guide:
Use the 'Confirm price' button on an offer - it fills the Search ID and Offer ID.
- If 'Price changed' is true, tell the customer BOTH prices and only book if they accept.
- 'Can be held' false = this fare can only be booked and paid, not held.
- The confirmation expires (see 'Expires at'); after that, confirm again.
- Idempotency key: any text unique to THIS attempt (e.g. your initials + date + time: AB-1021-1435). Repeating the same key repeats nothing - NDC answers the first result again, so a retry after a timeout is safe. Use a NEW key for a new request.

data.name: Look up booking
data.description: Finds a booking of this agency by airline PNR or NDC booking reference.

inputs.name: pnrOrReference
inputs.label: Airline PNR or NDC booking reference
inputs.description: Airline PNR or NDC booking reference

data.usage_guide:
Looks up ONE booking that belongs to this agency, by the airline PNR (e.g. HVPQXR) or the NDC booking reference (e.g. NDCEG-BR-F260726HPAdpY) - the input pnrOrReference.
- The value comes FROM THE CUSTOMER. Remove spaces; send a PNR in capital letters, an NDC reference exactly as given. Never guess one, never use a passport number, phone or name instead.
- Run it before answering ANY question about an existing booking.
RESULT: route, flightLegs (airline, departureDateTime, arrivalDateTime), passengers (name, ticketNumber when issued), statusText (API accounts) or status (PORTAL accounts), holdDeadline, system. A holdDeadline with no ticket numbers = ON HOLD, not ticketed. Report only what the result shows.
NOT FOUND = no booking with that reference belongs to this agency: say so and ask the customer to re-check it; for older API-system bookings the NDC booking reference may be needed instead of the PNR.

data.name: More offers (page, sort, filter)
data.description: Pages, sorts and filters the offers of an existing flight search (needs its Search ID).

inputs.name: searchId
inputs.label: Search ID (from a Search flights result)
inputs.description: Search ID (from a Search flights result)

inputs.name: sort
inputs.label: Sort: price_asc, price_desc, duration, departure, arrival, recommended
inputs.description: Sort: price_asc, price_desc, duration, departure, arrival, recommended

inputs.name: airline
inputs.label: Airline code(s) to keep, comma-separated (e.g. MS,NE)
inputs.description: Airline code(s) to keep, comma-separated (e.g. MS,NE)

data.usage_guide:
Shows more offers of an EXISTING search (page, sort, filter). You need the Search ID from a Search flights result - the 'More offers / filter' button fills it in for you.
- Sort: price_asc, price_desc, duration, departure, arrival, recommended (default).
- Filters are optional; leave a field empty to ignore it. Airline and cabin accept comma-separated values (MS,NE). Times are HH:mm local. refundableOnly = true keeps fully refundable fares only.
- Page is 1-based; pageSize is 1-50 (default 10). For the next page use 'Run again' on the result and raise the page number by one.

data.name: NDC login (token)
data.description: Logs the agency into NDC and returns the bearer token. Runs automatically before every other NDC action - agents never need to run it themselves.
data.usage_guide: Automatic prerequisite of every NDC action. The agency code and passcode come from the tenant variables ndc_agency_code / ndc_passcode - never ask the customer for them.

inputs.description: Search ID (from a Search flights result)

data.name: NDC Portal bot · multi-city request
data.description: NDC Portal chatbot only: collects a multi-city request (legs + travellers) for the agent. The bot never runs it — the NDC API has no multi-city search.

data.name: NDC Portal bot · search flights
data.description: Search NDC for one-way or round-trip flights. Shows the first 10 offers as cards; each offer has an 'Offer details' button, and 'More offers / filter' pages the same search.

inputs.name: origin
inputs.label: From airport (3-letter IATA code, e.g. CAI)
inputs.description: From airport (3-letter IATA code, e.g. CAI)

inputs.name: destination
inputs.label: To airport (3-letter IATA code, e.g. JED)
inputs.description: To airport (3-letter IATA code, e.g. JED)

inputs.name: returnDate
inputs.label: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) - leave empty for one-way
inputs.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) - leave empty for one-way

data.usage_guide:
NDC Portal chatbot only. Searches NDC for flights. Fill the inputs yourself from what the customer said - never ask for a code or a format.
- origin / destination: 3-letter IATA airport codes ONLY. Convert names (English or Arabic) yourself:
  Egypt: Cairo/القاهرة/مصر=CAI, Alexandria/الإسكندرية=HBE, Sharm El Sheikh/شرم الشيخ=SSH, Hurghada/الغردقة=HRG, Luxor/الأقصر=LXR, Aswan/أسوان=ASW, Marsa Alam=RMF, Sohag=HMB, Assiut=ATZ.
  Saudi: Jeddah/جدة=JED, Riyadh/الرياض=RUH, Dammam/الدمام=DMM, Medina/المدينة=MED, Mecca/مكة (no airport) = JED, Abha=AHB, Taif=TIF, Tabuk=TUU.
  Gulf: Dubai/دبي=DXB, Abu Dhabi/أبوظبي=AUH, Sharjah/الشارقة=SHJ, Doha/الدوحة=DOH, Kuwait/الكويت=KWI, Bahrain/البحرين=BAH, Muscat/مسقط=MCT.
  Levant/N.Africa: Amman/عمان=AMM, Beirut/بيروت=BEY, Baghdad/بغداد=BGW, Erbil=EBL, Casablanca=CMN, Tunis=TUN, Algiers=ALG, Khartoum=KRT.
  Other: Istanbul/إسطنبول=IST, London=LHR, Paris=CDG, Frankfurt=FRA, Rome=FCO, Madrid=MAD, Athens=ATH, New York=JFK, Kuala Lumpur=KUL, Bangkok=BKK, Mumbai=BOM, Delhi=DEL, Karachi=KHI, Lahore=LHE, Dhaka=DAC.
  A code the customer typed (e.g. "cai", "jed") -> send it in capitals. A place not listed and not certain -> ask once which airport they mean; never guess a code.
- departureDate / returnDate: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later, resolved from today's date ("tomorrow", "next Friday", "15/5"). returnDate only for a round trip, after departureDate.
- adults: 1 if not said; children 2-11; infants under 2 (never more than adults). Leave children/infants empty when none.
- cabin: only when asked - ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS or FIRST.
RESULT: searchId, totalResults and firstPage (best options first). Each offer has airline, origin, destination, departureTime/arrivalTime (local), durationMinutes, stops (0 = direct), cabin, price {amount, currency}, refundable, baggageSummary. Quote prices EXACTLY as returned - never round, convert or add. totalResults 0 = no flights that day: say so and suggest another date. Results expire after about 10 minutes (expiresAt): search again if the customer returns later.
ERRORS: "rejected the search" = a wrong code or date - fix the input (do not ask the customer for a code) or explain which value is wrong. "temporarily unavailable"/"took too long" = tell the customer NDC is busy and they can try again in a moment; do not repeat the search in the same turn.

data.name: NDC Portal bot · sign-in check
data.description: NDC Portal chatbot: checks the agency code and passcode the customer types (POST /chatbot/v1/auth/token). Read-only.

data.name: NDC wallet balance
data.description: Shows the agency's NDC wallet balance, credit limit and outstanding amount.
data.usage_guide:
Returns the logged-in agency's wallet balance (one pot of money). No inputs - just run it whenever the customer asks about their balance, wallet, credit or funds, every time (balances change).
RESULT: walletAmount, availableCredit, creditLimit, topupBalance, outstanding - each {amount, currency} - plus blocked and system. Report the values EXACTLY as returned with their currency; never add, subtract or convert. A missing/null value = not reported by the system (say "not reported", never 0). blocked=true = spending from the wallet is blocked: tell the customer to contact NDC support.

data.name: Offer details
data.description: Opens one offer's full detail (itinerary, fare, baggage). Needs the Search ID and the Offer ID - the 'Offer details' button on a result fills both in.
data.usage_guide: Use the 'Offer details' button on an offer card - it fills the Search ID and Offer ID. The 'details' block is the supplier's raw itinerary and fare data. Offers expire with their search; if NDC answers 'expired', run a new Search flights.

data.name: Pay this hold
data.description: Pays a held booking from the agency wallet. Spends money.

inputs.name: bookingRef
inputs.label: Booking id, PNR or booking reference
inputs.description: Booking id, PNR or booking reference

inputs.name: acceptPriceChange
inputs.label: Accept price change (true only after the customer agreed)
inputs.description: Accept price change (true only after the customer agreed)

inputs.name: Idempotency-Key
inputs.label: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)
inputs.description: Idempotency key (unique text per attempt, e.g. AB-1021-1435)

data.usage_guide:
The booking is re-priced first. If NDC answers that the price changed, tell the customer both prices; if they accept, run again with 'Accept price change' = true and a NEW idempotency key.
- Idempotency key: any text unique to THIS attempt (e.g. your initials + date + time: AB-1021-1435). Repeating the same key repeats nothing - NDC answers the first result again, so a retry after a timeout is safe. Use a NEW key for a new request.

  Gulf: Dubai/دبي=DXB, Abu Dhabi/أبوظبي=AUH, Sharjah/الشارقة=SHJ, Doha/الدوحة=DOH, Kuwait/الكويت=KWI, Bahrain/البحرين=BAH, Muscat/مسقط=MCT.
  Levant/N.Africa: Amman/عمان=AMM, Beirut/بيروت=BEY, Baghdad/بغداد=BGW, Erbil=EBL, Casablanca=CMN, Tunis=TUN, Algiers=ALG, Khartoum=KRT.
  Other: Istanbul/إسطنبول=IST, London=LHR, Paris=CDG, Frankfurt=FRA, Rome=FCO, Madrid=MAD, Athens=ATH, New York=JFK, Kuala Lumpur=KUL, Bangkok=BKK, Mumbai=BOM, Delhi=DEL, Karachi=KHI, Lahore=LHE, Dhaka=DAC.
  A code the customer typed (e.g. "cai", "jed") -> send it in capitals. A place not listed and not certain -> ask once which airport they mean; never guess a code.
- departureDate / returnDate: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later, resolved from today's date ("tomorrow", "next Friday", "15/5"). returnDate only for a round trip, after departureDate.
- adults: 1 if not said; children 2-11; infants under 2 (never more than adults). Leave children/infants empty when none.
- cabin: only when asked - ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS or FIRST.
RESULT: searchId, totalResults and firstPage (best options first). Each offer has airline, origin, destination, departureTime/arrivalTime (local), durationMinutes, stops (0 = direct), cabin, price {amount, currency}, refundable, baggageSummary. Quote prices EXACTLY as returned - never round, convert or add. totalResults 0 = no flights that day: say so and suggest another date. Results expire after about 10 minutes (expiresAt): search again if the customer returns later.
ERRORS: "rejected the search" = a wrong code or date - fix the input (do not ask the customer for a code) or explain which value is wrong. "temporarily unavailable"/"took too long" = tell the customer NDC is busy and they can try again in a moment; do not repeat the search in the same turn.

data.usage_guide:
PORTAL accounts (this agency): no money moves here - a refund is a separate manual step. Same-calendar-day voids only.
- Idempotency key: any text unique to THIS attempt (e.g. your initials + date + time: AB-1021-1435). Repeating the same key repeats nothing - NDC answers the first result again, so a retry after a timeout is safe. Use a NEW key for a new request.
